create_counter: create a Counter instance with an optional parent counter and string prefix for hierarchical counting
increment_counter: increment named counters by passing keyword arguments to Counter.increment and retrieve all current counts
get_counts: retrieve all tracked counts from a Counter by calling Counter.get_counts which merges local and parent counts
save_restore_counter: save and restore Counter state using Counter.save and Counter.restore for checkpointing distributed counters
get_steps_key: get the steps key name from a Counter using Counter.get_steps_key which returns prefix-qualified or plain steps key
